title: Verify a webhook signature
summary: The gate refuses, with 403 and before any route runs, a request whose signature header does not match hex(HMAC(signing_key, url + raw_body)). X-Signalwire-SHA256-Signature decides when present; otherwise X-Signalwire-Signature, the SHA-1 one, does.
scenario: A public webhook that refuses any request without a valid SignalWire signature
